jobs.did: Issued consumer loans at bank points inside Foxtrot, Eldorado, Comfy and KTS stores; set up cards, deposits and other banking products in a bank with a strong corporate culture of honesty, transparency and personal responsibility.
qa: Zero-error paperwork: every loan file had to match bank rules before sign-off
Honesty and transparency: reporting problems as they are, never hiding a risk, which is what a bug report must do
Personal responsibility: owning the result of my work up to the final check
Explaining complex products in plain words, the same skill as a clear bug report
Banking domain knowledge I reuse when testing fintech flows

jobs.did: Built a wholesale dealer network for Tikkurila, Kolorit and Tex in the Rivne region: built and analysed the client database, handled objections in negotiations, ran contracts, accounting documents, order follow-up and internal processes.
qa: Building and analysing the client database: segmenting data, spotting gaps and duplicates, the same eye I use on test data
Handling objections: hearing the real concern behind a "no" and answering with facts, which is how I discuss bug severity with developers
Internal processes: order → contract → delivery → documents, end-to-end thinking for testing business flows
Working with many stakeholders and following every request to closure

jobs.did: Ran the sales floor of a store with a large product range: goods receiving and checking deliveries against invoices, regular stock inventories, staff training and accounting reports.
qa: Goods receiving: checking every delivery against the invoice, the same expected-vs-actual habit as acceptance testing
Stock inventories: reconciling records with what is really on the shelf and finding where the numbers break
Large product range handled with checklists and system, not memory
Looking at the product from the customer's side, the core of UX testing
Training staff and checking work against standards, the habit behind reviews
